Compiles Cartesian motion waypoints into discrete joint steps and binary move frames.

Compiles Cartesian motion waypoints into discrete joint steps and binary move frames.

attributes:

compile_motion_step(*, waypoint: Waypoint, seq_num: int, prev_angles: tuple[float, float, float, float], line_num: int) → tuple[Step, tuple[float, float, float, float]][source]¶

Compiles a motion waypoint into a binary joint move step.

Parameters:

  • waypoint – Target Cartesian waypoint.

  • seq_num – Frame sequence counter.

  • prev_angles – Previous joint angles tuple.

  • line_num – Source line index.

Returns:

Tuple of compiled Step and updated joint angles tuple.

Exceptions:

ValueError if kinematic solving fails.
